integrity: Both exact facet lists are embedded. Integral H2 is reconstructed from boundary matrices by unimodular integer operations, every four-vertex support is exhausted, and every minimum carrier is checked for nonzero primitive integral class before comparing the two spectra.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns minimum vertex support in two fixed labelled twelve-vertex triangulations. Computational homology coordinates are not canonical intersection-form bases; only the up-to-sign class multiplicities and their mod-two merger pattern are claimed invariant.
title: Integral shortest-carrier spectra distinguish two twelve-vertex projective-plane connected sums
